names.zh: 卡利班甘早期犁耕田垄

summary.zh: Lal 等 MASI 98 报告中的早期哈拉帕农业田垄遗迹；为犁耕/畜力牵引提供物质线索（Kenoyer 综述亦引）。
summary.en: Early Harappan agricultural field grid as reported in Lal et al. MASI 98; material evidence for plow/traction farming (also cited in Kenoyer’s survey).
